sources.name: National Emergency Management Organization
sources.notes: Government emergency department; its role page describes national emergency responsibilities and nine named emergency committees. The coordinator page separately names district and local offices. Returned feed latest item is 25 May 2026 procurement; warnings visible in this feed are from November 2024. A successful fetch does not establish current emergency-alert delivery. Metadata discovery only; no automatic incident promotion. Geographic completeness remains unverified.

sources.name: Breaking Belize News
sources.notes: Publisher describes a Belizean-owned newsroom and correspondents in Toledo, Corozal, Orange Walk, Cayo and Belmopan. Beneficial ownership is not established by this statement. Robots declares a 30-second crawl delay. Future same-host retrieval must respect it. The national mission does not establish two local outlets in every district/constituency. Metadata discovery only; no automatic incident promotion. Geographic completeness remains unverified.

sources.name: Amandala
sources.notes: First-party about page identifies publisher Evan X Hyde and its relationship with KREM/KREM TV. Those related outlets must not be counted as independent corroboration. Public feed contains links/headlines, including subscriber editions. Subscription-only content must not be bypassed. Current robots response contains explanatory content-signal comments but no actual allow/deny signal. Metadata discovery only; no automatic incident promotion. Geographic completeness remains unverified.

sources.name: The San Pedro Sun
sources.notes: First-party about page identifies Tamara and Ron Sniffin as owners/operators and an explicit Ambergris Caye/San Pedro community-journalism remit. Distribution elsewhere is not evidence of a local reporting beat. Feed uses HTTP gzip and must be decoded before strict XML parsing; the existing collector supports that encoding. Site privacy policy is not a general content-republication licence. Metadata discovery only; no automatic incident promotion. Geographic completeness remains unverified.

sources.name: Government of Belize Press Office
sources.notes: The Economic Development Council government directory links the official Press Office under the Office of the Prime Minister. Current feed contains dated government releases. A general government-release feed, not a guarantee that all police, health or transport incidents are included. Official releases syndicated by news outlets remain one source account. Metadata discovery only; no automatic incident promotion. Geographic completeness remains unverified.

sources.name: Belize Police Department
sources.notes: Departmental site describes national police functions and provides forms, official contacts and a commissioner message. The separate .gov directory did not directly authenticate this domain in the reviewed material. Attempted /feed/ returns 404. Robots directives are concatenated into one malformed line, so automated-access permission is unresolved. The station directory page has no readable station listing in the retrieved HTML, so district-specific public update streams are unverified. Metadata discovery only; no automatic incident promotion. Geographic completeness remains unverified.

sources.name: Ministry of Health and Wellness
sources.notes: The Economic Development Council government directory directly links health.gov.bz. Current homepage is contact-only; the feed is a placeholder, not a health-alert stream. /northern-region/ returns 404 and RSS contains only a 13 June 2025 Hello world entry. Do not activate this as a health monitoring feed. Metadata discovery only; no automatic incident promotion. Geographic completeness remains unverified.

sources.name: Ministry of Infrastructure Development and Housing
sources.notes: Government ministry domain and first-party national road-management/project descriptions. Government directory independently lists the ministry and matching official email domain. Returned feed has five items and newest is 22 October 2021. Project descriptions are background, not current road closures. Do not activate as a live transport-warning feed. Metadata discovery only; no automatic incident promotion. Geographic completeness remains unverified.
